haikus.haiku:
Amber liquid glows,
Aged wood whispers ancient tales,
Cheers fill the warm air.
Happy #NationalScotchDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Tall trees sway and bend,
Laughter dances in the breeze,
Step high, hearts take flight.
Happy #WalkOnStiltsDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bouncing through the vale,
Carrots crisp in bright sunlight,
Laughter fills the air.
#HappyBirthdayBugsBunny from @ClamBakeSanta
